References

How to Cite

General reference to this package: Gonzalez2025code

In case of using the NN-CC method, additionally cite:

  • Gonzalez, F. J. and Lara, L. P. “Interpretable neural network system identification method for two families of second-order systems based on characteristic curves.” Nonlinear Dyn. (2025)

In case of using the Poly-CC method, additionally cite:

  • Gonzalez, F.J. “Determination of the characteristic curves of a nonlinear first order system from fourier analysis.” Sci. Rep., vol. 13, 1955, (2023).

  • Gonzalez, F.J. “System identification based on characteristic curves: a mathematical connection between power series and Fourier analysis for first-order nonlinear systems.” Nonlinear Dyn. 112, 16167–16197 (2024).

In case of using post-SR and/or SymbReg-CC methods, additionally cite:

  • Cranmer, M. “Interpretable Machine Learning for Science with PySR and SymbolicRegression.jl.” arXiv preprint arXiv:2305.01582 (2023).
